public_sources.identity: Nature Communications article title, authors, and exact DOI match current_state.csv and local text heading.
public_sources.access: Public article text was accessible in one read-only open; later DOI resolution attempt to Figshare was unavailable through the web tool. No publisher challenge was encountered during the article read.
public_sources.finding: Article describes the active model phase as gamma-NiFeOOH and constructs NiFeOOH with oxygen vacancies near Fe. It assigns theoretical OER overpotentials: pristine NiFeOOH Fe 1.14 eV, Ni 1.36 eV; NiFeOOH-Vo Fe 0.19 eV, Ni 0.68 eV. Figure 6g says its chlorine-water Pourbaix diagram is based on corresponding theoretical overpotentials for NiFeOOH-Vo and IrO2.
public_sources.limit: No explicit crystallographic model facet/surface termination was found in the article text for the plotted models; the Fig. 6g potentials are not individually labelled as eta/minimum UL beyond the caption's 'based on' wording. This duplicates the already reviewed article content and does not close the approved hold.
